ReTzar, a fan remake of Tzar: The Burden of the Crown.

Run ReTzar.exe. The first time, choose the folder where Tzar is installed
(any edition: CD, GOG or Steam, in any language): ReTzar checks that you
own the game and remembers it. Your settings and saves stay here.

Windows may say that it protected your PC, since the game isn't signed:
click "More info", then "Run anyway".

Source code and help: https://github.com/ColCarlo/ReTzar
Code: GPL-3.0-or-later (see LICENSE.txt). Game data: Haemimont Games,
Take-Two Interactive and FX Interactive, free by their permission (see
DATA-LICENSE.txt). An unofficial fan project.
